specification.objective: Resolve the desktop Backlog overflow and crowded row actions, and remove secondary informational chips from workspace sidebars without changing navigation, permissions, or business behavior.

requirements.statement: Backlog columns wider than available desktop content remain reachable through discoverable horizontal scrolling within the table; headers and cells stay aligned and vertical scrolling remains available.
Backlog row actions occupy a dedicated Ações column; Título contains only title hierarchy/content and retains at least 160 logical pixels for text at a 1440 logical-pixel viewport.
All secondary informational highlight chips are removed from workspace sidebars; operationally important state remains in appropriate page content and navigation/permissions remain unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Backlog table exposes a visible horizontal scrollbar for overflowing columns, supports horizontal navigation, and avoids whole-page horizontal overflow.

Every Backlog row has an aligned Ações cell separate from Título; existing permission-aware action callbacks, tooltips, busy/disabled states, and minimum 48x48 targets remain intact; title text remains at least 160 logical pixels at 1440 width.

No secondary informational chips, empty wrappers, or chip spacing remain in workspace sidebars across all call sites; navigation, active route, logout, responsive layout, collapse behavior, and page-content status remain intact.
Desktop expanded, mobile, light, and dark workspace sidebar visual baselines are updated to show no secondary informational chips.
This versioned contract supersedes the prior Backlog layout contract only for the table columns/actions layout, preserving 160-pixel title and 48x48 action-target requirements.

invariants.statement: Preserve Backlog data, sorting, filtering, row identity, card ordering, actions, permissions, and backend behavior.
Do not remove functional badges or status labels in main content, or alter geolocation, audit, data masking, or permission behavior.
Do not introduce dependencies or permanently hide table columns or content.

forbidden_states.statement: Backlog actions share the Título cell or table content is unreachable due to overflow.
Any secondary informational chip remains in a workspace sidebar or essential page status is lost.
Navigation, permissions, callbacks, accessibility semantics, responsive behavior, or required visual baselines regress.

inputs.statement: Backlog columns, card rows, action availability, viewport width, workspace sidebar content, and theme.

outputs.statement: Scrollable, readable Backlog table with a dedicated actions column and clean workspace sidebars.

failure_semantics.statement: Regression tests fail with backlog_horizontal_scrollbar, backlog_actions_column, workspace_sidebar_chips_removed, or the named workspace visual case when a requirement is violated.
